_comment: Reviewed image-digest registry (Spec 17 R17-11 / Spec 19 R19-15).
Each entry maps a canonical 'name:tag' to the immutable digest that was
resolved and re-verified for that tag. Manifests pin 'name:tag@sha256:<digest>'
and scripts/check_image_pins.py fails the build if a manifest pin is missing,
malformed, unreviewed, or disagrees with the digest recorded here.
Refresh procedure: resolve the tag (docker buildx imagetools inspect
<name>:<tag>, or the registry manifest API), confirm the digest, update this
file and every manifest in the same commit, and record the review date.
